text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: spike in auth failures and 401s from multiple ephemeral IPs against /api/v1/auth (us-east-1). ~6x baseline in last 2m. Potential token leakage or replay. Alert: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/3500004321 :pager:

sara-ops: oncall-night are you on? seeing same in logs. tagging mike-security.

oncall-night: i'm awake, picking this up. building quick triage.

mike-security: thanks. first things: (1) block identified IPs at edge, (2) rotate any exposed service tokens, (3) check if any log sinks recently changed. i'm looking at audit-logs now.

sara-ops: edge block applied: ipset add suspicious-list 203.0.113.0/24 (edge-fw). confirming propagation.

alex-eng: i can patch rate-limiter to drop the main path for those IPs and add a temporary strict auth header check. pushing a tiny canary to edge (5%).

lisa-cs: heads up — we have a handful of customers in us-east with elevated 401s, chatting with them now to assess impact. no major customer complaints yet.

mike-security: audit: found repeated requests with header X-Client-Auth: "eyJhbGci..." pattern from a staging collector host. possible logforwarder misconfig. checking last deploys to observability.

incident-bot: deploybot: observability-forwarder v2.3.7 rolled to staging at 2025-07-22T01:09:12Z by deployer-bot.

sara-ops: can we confirm whether any S3 log buckets had public ACL changes last 24h? i see one indexer forwarder with new role. tagging legal for notification need.

mike-security: fast checks: s3 ls --region us-east-1 s3://rwd-staging-logs | tail -n 20  -> found recent bundle with scrub flag false. opening ticket to rotate ingest credentials.

alex-eng: quick mitigation: disabled forwarder writestream to external-bucket in staging. will push a config to turn on scrub=true cluster-wide.

oncall-night: rolling credential rotation plan: (a) revoke staging ingest key id ABCD-1234, (b) issue new key for forwarder with least privilege, (c) invalidate any tokens older than 12h for that service. I'll coordinate a short maintenance window.

mike-security: legal, advise on whether we need customer notification prepped. looks like candidate exposure is internal staging logs referencing tokens.

legal: please preserve all relevant logs and comms. we'll need a timeline and scope before deciding notification. standby for a short form we can reuse if customer PII or credentials appear.

lisa-cs: i'm drafting a cautious customer message template in case we escalate. will wait for scope.

sara-ops: indicators: unusual IPs, header pattern, forwarder write to s3 without scrub. severity: medium until we confirm tokens leaked externally.

oncall-night: running a grep across retained buckets for the header pattern now, and requesting a temporary hold on any automated deletion for last 48h on the staging buckets.

mike-security: if grep finds hits, we'll do immediate key rotation and run a targeted replay detection against token use. also prepare WAF rule to block the header pattern as an immediate signature.

incident-bot: pager cleared? not yet. monitoring continues. next update in 10m or on request.

sara-ops: update: edge blocks stable, rate limiter applied, forwarder writes paused. grep: 3 matches in staging-logs/2025-07-21/collector-*.gz referencing the X-Client-Auth header.

mike-security: ok confirmed. proceed with rotations now. oncall-night coordinate key rotation and post the rotation ids here. i'll run replay detection and search for any customer token reuse.

oncall-night: rotated ingest key id-> NEW-RO-9876, old key revoked. posted rotation job id: rot-3500004321-01.

mike-security: started replay detection job job-3500004321-replay. ETA ~12m.

legal: keep the timeline brief and exact. we'll review results of replay detection before calling any regulator or customer.

lisa-cs: noted — drafting holding message. will only send if legal advises.

sara-ops: final for now: mitigations in place, limited confirmed exposure in staging logs only, no confirmed production customer credential leak. monitoring + security runbook steps executing. will escalate if replay finds customer token use.

mike-security: thanks team. if replay finds questionable token use we'll open an incident impact thread and notify legal + CS immediately. otherwise we'll close pager after 1hr of normalizing metrics. :thumbsup:
